title: Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation
statement: For any morphism g:X -> Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and finitely presented module M on Y [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], the tensor pullback g^*M [def-pc-module-pullback] is finitely presented on X. No flatness of g is assumed.

proof.text: The concrete tensor pullback and the native scheme module pullback are left adjoint to the same pushforward. Use nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, then Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, to identify them. The existing proved instance AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFinitePresentation_pullback in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent preserves finite presentation for the native pullback. Transfer that property along the comparison using isFinitePresentation_of_iso. This argument includes arbitrary morphisms, zero modules and empty schemes.
